entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Dotnet process running, but no reaction is shown #119043
  • [API Proposal]: ToObservable and ToAsyncEnumerable() #119040

Closed

  • [API Proposal]: ISorted<T> for sorted collections #119036

PullRequests

Created

  • Use collection expressions for UnmanagedCallConv.CallConvs #119042
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices, community-contribution
  • Instrument stackalloc for PGO #119041
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Disable UnhandledExceptionHandler tests with native components on `llvmfullaot` #119039
    disabled-test, area-VM-meta-mono, runtime-mono

Merged

  • Make wasm corerun build regular #119029
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • [release/9.0-staging] [wasm][AOT] fix codegen for small structs on stack #118416
    Servicing-approved, arch-wasm, area-Codegen-AOT-mono, os-browser, 9.0.10
  • Fix GCStress regression #119028
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Throttle finalization a bit when doing GC stress. #118879
    GCStress, area-VM-coreclr

Updated

  • [cDAC] Implement GetMethodTableSlot and GetMethodTableSlotEnum #118960
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • [release/8.0] Bump usages of MicroBuild task to v4 #119027
    Servicing-approved, 8.0.x
  • JIT: Consistently DNER promoted parameters on arm32 #118953
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [NativeAOT] Fix floating pointer register unwinding on Arm32 #118944
    arch-arm32, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Fix DateTimeOffset deserialization in IXmlSerializable context #119030
    area-Serialization
  • Fixes trying to create a module using a trash as the address of the module #119031
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Enhance consistency of StreamReader and StreamWriter #118958
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • Replace Marshal.PtrToStringUni and Marshal.StringToCoTaskMemUni with Utf16StringMarshaller #118997
